name: IRC_AVAILABILITY_CONTEXT
description: This table is used to store the configuration data for availability context in recruiting. Each row represents a dimension value in a context.

columns.name: OBJECT_CTX_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Sequence generated key. Fusion Global sequence generator is used to generate the key at run-time.

columns.name: OBJECT_CTX_CODE
columns.description: Object Context Code is used for data migration purpose. This column will be populated with a GUID value to uniquely identify a row across environments

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Business Object ID - It can be CSP ID / Apply Flow ID / Content Library Id .. etc

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Business Object Type - It can be ORA_CSP or ORA_APPLY_FLOW or ORA_CONTENT_LIBRARY .. etc depends on the business object type

columns.name: RECRUITING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Recruiting Type Code

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Organization Id

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NODE_ID
columns.description: Geography Node Id

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Job ID

columns.name: JOB_FAMILY_ID
columns.description: Job Family Id

columns.name: JOB_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Job Function Code

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Career Site Number refers to IRC_CX_SITES_B.SITE_NUMBER column and defines career site dimension of availability context

columns.name: PERSON_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Person Type Code

columns.name: DIMENSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Dimension Type Code - E.g Values :  ORA_RECRUITING_TYPE , ORA_JOB_FAMILY, ORA_JOB_FUNCTION, ORA_LOCATION, ORA_ORGANIZATION, ORA_PERSON_TYPE

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Default Flag - Values are 'Y' or 'N'

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
